title: Grawa-Wasserfall Stubaital
highlights: Widest waterfall in the entire Eastern Alps measuring an impressive 85 meters across
Spectacular drop of 180 meters cascading over rugged gneiss rock ledges
Health-enhancing aerosol microclimate clinically proven to benefit the respiratory system
Easily accessible ergonomic wooden loungers along the celebrated WildeWasserWeg
kurzbeschreibung: The Grawa-Wasserfall in the rear Stubaital is the widest waterfall in the Eastern Alps at 85 metres and a designated natural monument.
beschreibung:
A Record-Breaking Natural Monument in the Stubaital

The Grawa-Wasserfall in the rear Stubaital plunges approximately 180 metres down over massive rock ledges, spanning a width of up to 85 metres to form the widest waterfall in the Eastern Alps. This majestic natural spectacle is fed by the vast glaciers surrounding the Stubaier Gletscher.

Rest and Vitality along the WildeWasserWeg

Scientific studies confirm the health-boosting benefits of the fine water spray for the respiratory system. Directly at the foot of the falls, ergonomically crafted wooden loungers invite visitors to inhale the invigorating mist and relax. The waterfall serves as the impressive centrepiece of the award-winning Stubaier WildeWasserWeg.
